['Michelin Reifenwerke AG & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Michelin Reifenwerke AG & Co. KGaA is a tire manufacturer and a leader in sustainable mobility. The company develops tires, services, and solutions to improve mobility sustainably for over 130 years. Michelin is known for its high-quality and performance tires for automobiles, motorcycles, and bicycles, offering superior grip, safety, and durability. The company's products are mainly sold under the Michelin, BFGoodrich, Kleber, Uniroyal, and Taurus brands.

['IDS Logistik GmbH '].company_description: IDS Logistik GmbH operates as a piece goods cooperation, expanding its network capacities in the Berlin region. The company celebrated its 40th anniversary in 2022 and has been an important partner in the stable network of the Andreas Schmid Group for years.
